"Hi Mr. Wu, thank u so much for meeting with me today!! I wanted to follow up about the TEAS. Yes, a bit long. Here's the short version:

"Hi Mr. Wu, thanks for meeting with me today. I plan to take the TEAS in summer 2026. Is the fee $70, and are there any fee waivers? Can the TEAS fit into Denny's map without changing the prereq order? I'm aiming to apply to the RN program in 2027 and hopefully work at St. Anselm, so I want to get the sequence right. Thank you!"

Note: you wrote "Denny's map" in a message to him. If you'd rather say "the plan you mapped out for me," swap that in.
